announcements.title: PhDRacket 0.1.3 Beta is available
announcements.body: Version 0.1.3 Beta checks your program while you type (errors, unused names, scopes, Rename), suggests names, and adds a debugger with breakpoints and stepping, an Outline of the file, and source control with Git. To update, click the Update button in the status bar, or open About and choose Check for updates.
